scope: One bounded live recovery from DHCP-granted ARP conflict to another address
validated: First address never configured; server receives matching DECLINE
Retained retry context enforces at least ten seconds before next native client
Fresh pipe/process with same explicit MAC-based option61 identity
Second actual OFFER/ACK assigns a different address
Lease generation advances after first retirement/removal acknowledgements
Native process IDs/DNS/routes and parent namespace preserved
limitations: One repository-authored two-address fixture; not arbitrary DHCP-server acceptance
No running music endpoints or ongoing-service conflict
No production broker, unbounded retry or continuous refresh/expiry integration
No target4.4 runtime, physical AZ or actual-CDJ acceptance
